premise.claim: RBG status synchronization only compared Replicas and ReadyReplicas, so changes to UpdatedReplicas alone were ignored, leaving stale rollout progress even after repeated reconciliations.
premise.evidence: results/unit-base.json: UpdatedReplicas-only contract tests FAIL on base 7894133d; results/integration-base.json: API server retains stale updatedReplicas=1 after reconcile
